title: SKE Crystal Pink Lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Pink Lemonade flavour from SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid combines the refreshing zest of lemonade with the sweet, juicy undertones of red summer berries, creating a vibrant and flavoursome vaping experience. This delightful blend is perfect for those who enjoy a citrusy, fruity profile with a touch of berry sweetness. Part of SKE’s premium Nic Salts range, this e-liquid delivers a smoother throat hit thanks to its nicotine salt formulation, making it an excellent choice for vapers seeking a gentle yet effective nicotine delivery. The 50VG/50PG mix is optimized for mouth-to-lung vaping, providing a perfect balance between flavour intensity and cloud production. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
